Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Sit Pose 0 and Doze (bed) Pose 0 animations are now detected and get Play buttons.
- Settings now lists selected mods that are no longer in Penumbra, so you can remove them.
- Mods deleted or renamed in Penumbra are removed from or kept in your scan selection automatically.
